name: Bharwa Parwal Tofu
ingredients: Saunf, amchur, turmeric and 1 tsp oil
steps: Mash tofu with spices and stuff parwal.
Cook covered with tomato and a little water.
note: Tofu filling avoids a heavy, high-saturated-fat filling.

inspirationReferences.title: Parwal ki Sabji | Easy Aloo Parwal Recipe
inspirationReferences.note: Pointed-gourd preparation, cleaning and gentle pan-cooking; our stuffed tofu filling is a distinct adaptation.
